reports.title: Enquête annuelle sur les moyens consacrés à la recherche et au développement dans les associations et les groupements d’intérêt public
title_aliases: Annual survey of resources committed to research and development in associations and public interest groups
reports.publisher: SIES -- Sous-direction des systèmes d'information et des études statistiques, French Ministry for Higher Education and Research
reports.description: Annual, compulsory SIES survey of R&D spending, researcher numbers and funding in associations and public-interest groupings (GIP) -- the companion to the enterprise R&D survey (fr-sies-rd-survey-enterprises), run by the same office. The GNI inventory's Ch 10.1.4 survey table gives it its own row, distinct from the enterprise survey's row, with a 320-unit sample against administrative files. Still active: CNIS's own survey register lists it as running through the 2022-2026 cycle (registration 2025A703RE), and the Ministry's own current page for the 2025 edition gives a dedicated contact address for associations/GIP respondents (enqretd-assoc@recherche.gouv.fr), confirming the survey stream is distinct from the enterprise one and still live.
reports.cadence_note: The inventory's own survey table states periodicity 'Annual', matching the enterprise survey.

reports.title: Base Tous Salariés (BTS)
reports.description: INSEE's current annual statistical base of individual-level data on all employees (positions, employees, enterprises and establishments files), built from employers' administrative declarations. INSEE's own metadata page states this source succeeded DADS from the 2017 data vintage onward. Minted to record that succession alongside fr-dads (round 1), the same way DE's EVAS successor chains were tracked -- not because the 2010-benchmark GNI inventory names BTS itself, which it cannot: that document describes the methodology of the era when DADS was still the live source.
reports.cadence_note: Annual statistical base, one edition per data year (2018-2023 editions confirmed live at INSEE's own metadata pages).

Read in full against a fresh direct download of the inventory PDF (not a summarized fetch). 3.4.1 (S.121-S.128, p.90-95) names only agency-level registers and bodies already known to be out of scope or already wired by class: the Regafi register of financial agents (an administrative register, not a recurring statistical release -- same class as the retired index-page rulings), the AMF's approval/monitoring activity, the Caisse des dépôts et consignations' role, and the Esane/DGFiP repeats already wired via fr-dgfip-compte-general-etat. No survey or report is named by title that isn't already a wired node or an out-of-scope register. 5.8.2 (HFCE, p.262-265) describes the compilation PROCESS (expert assessment, VAT/FISIM adjustments, balancing) and names only 'panels of distributors Nielsen or GfK' as a source class -- private commercial panels, out of this project's official-statistics scope, and Esane again. 5.11.2 (GFCF, p.287-289) is Esane and DGFiP (already wired) for every institutional sector, with no additional named source. Nothing to mint in any of the three; do not re-read them on a future FR round unless the inventory itself is superseded by a newer edition.
